description: EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue is an open data portal listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by The European environmental Agency (EEA). The EEA SDI is a metadata catalogue service that facilitates the discovery of the data sets produced, acquired and, when possible, published by the EEA. Through the metadata, users can access information on the content and quality of the data sets, and ultimately download the data sets (restrictions may apply). Coverage: Europe. The European data portal lists 1,293 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 224 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 27 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
